newsitem.title: USA: American Diversified gets Mali,Guinea deal.
newsitem.headline: American Diversified gets Mali,Guinea deal.

text.p: American Diversified Group Inc said Tuesday it entered into a contract worth more than $2 million to supply telecommunications to corporations in Mali and Guinea.
The company said the deal will result in immediate monthly revenues and cash flow during the third quarter.
The company said it will supply telecommunications to multinational oil companies, mining companies, and financial institutions and foreign embassies in Mali and Guinea.
The company said its principal business involves the marketing, sale and distribution of products and services for the export market, with an emphasis on West Africa and South America.
